sections.heading: Learning Point 1
sections.content: About the Unit This unit at the preparatory stage familiarises students with different types of food, importance of balanced food, healthcare, and maintaining good health with regular exercise and rest.
sections.source_evidence: About the Unit This unit at the preparatory stage familiarises students with different types of food, importance of balanced food, healthcare, and maintaining good health with regular exercise and rest.

sections.heading: Learning Point 2
sections.content: Students also learn how traditional agricultural, and cultural practices supported health and well-being in sync with changes in seasons.

sections.heading: Learning Point 3
sections.content: This unit in Grade 5 helps students explore how everyday choices support personal and collective well-being.

sections.heading: Learning Point 4
sections.content: Students learn how to take care of food and explore various traditional Indian methods of food preservation.

sections.heading: Learning Point 5

sections.heading: Learning Point 6

sections.heading: Learning Point 7
sections.content: They learn how to make their school a greener, cleaner and more caring place through actions like waste management, water conservation, and practising kindness.
